entries.english:
Brothers Peter and Hans von Rosenberg sell to the parish priest Hans von Rosenberg and the Rosenberg church the rent from the Kothof for 21 talents of Viennese denarii.

In the name of the Lord, amen. Temporal business would often perish if it were not confirmed and secured by written documents. Therefore we, the brothers Peter and Hans von Rosenberg, publicly acknowledge to all, by this document, that since the 22 talents of Viennese denarii for which the farm in the village of Qnasow, belonging to the chapel of St Catherine in Rosenberg, had been sold were deposited in our custody, the prudent Johann, then rector of the parish church there in Rosenberg, earnestly petitioned us to sell, for increasing the revenues of that chapel, the rent from our farm commonly called ‘blalny dwor’, situated above the town of Rosenberg beside the road leading to Rychnow, then held by the resident Jessco called Walessa. We, considering that this would increase divine worship and the benefit of the chapel, and agreeing to his reasonable request, have duly and lawfully sold to that Johann, parish priest in Rosenberg, his successors, and the church in Rosenberg for the chapel of St Catherine there, by hereditary right, the rent owed each year by the aforesaid resident or rent-paying tenant of that farm, twelve solidi of Viennese denarii, payable in installments as a true annual rent. We sold it for the aforesaid 21 talents of Viennese denarii, which we acknowledge having received in full and in cash, transferring to Johann and his successors from now on every right we had in that rent. In good faith, in our own name and that of our successors, we promise to defend and fully free this purchase from anyone who challenges it, according to the custom and form of the law of the Kingdom of Bohemia observed to this day. We give this document as testimony, confirmed by the attachment of our seals. Given in the year of the Lord 1378, on the day after the feast of the glorious martyr St Valentine.

See nos. CIV and CXIV for the seals.
